name: aria-monorepo
description: Electron workspace UI with streamed Pi sessions.
author: Kumar Rahul Anand

scripts.build: bun run build:backend && bun run --cwd app build
scripts.release:linux: bun run build:backend && bun run check:backend && bun run --cwd app release:linux
scripts.release:windows: bun run build:backend && bun run check:backend && bun run --cwd app release:windows
scripts.test: bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/host test && bun run --cwd app test
scripts.typecheck: bun run --cwd packages/protocol typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/core typecheck && bun run --cwd packages/host typecheck && bun run --cwd app typecheck
scripts.check: bun run --cwd packages/protocol check && bun run --cwd packages/core check && bun run --cwd packages/host check && bun run --cwd app check && biome check scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
scripts.lint: biome check --write app packages scripts package.json tsconfig.base.json biome.json
